title: Operator Geometry of Hilbert Ball Automorphisms
summary: We consider the operator--theoretic model for the group of biholomorphic automorphisms $Aut(B)$ of the unit ball $B$ of a complex Hilbert space $\H$ by representing each automorphism as a bounded linear operator on the augmented Hilbert space $\H\oplus \mathbb{C}$. Any member of $Aut(B)$ admits a natural block operator matrix representation acting on $\mathcal{H}\oplus\mathbb{C}$. We study the geometry of the subset $M(\mathcal{H})$ of $\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H}\oplus\mathbb{C})$ consisting of these block operator matrices.
